sentences.en: As the world becomes economically richer, it becomes environmentally poorer.
sentences.zh: 随着世界变得更为富裕，它在环境上却变得更加贫穷。

sentences.en: We must presuppose that the wage paid is economically just.
sentences.zh: 我们必须假设所支付的工资是合乎经济正义的。

sentences.en: I believe that Algeria is poised to take off economically.
sentences.zh: 我相信阿尔及利亚即将在经济发展上腾飞。

senses.zh: 节约地,节省地,经济地,在经济上
